text: One-command local gate: Rscript tools/release-gate.R. Builds the clean tarball, runs docs/Rcpp consistency, R CMD check --as-cran, and a reviewed-skip inventory. Latest local pass: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 2 notes (CRAN incoming URL 404 for unpublished GitHub pages; non-standard CONTRIBUTING/_pkgdown). Evidence in .gate/latest.json (channel=local). Hosted evidence remains GitHub Actions. Publication evidence is separate.
